## Preferred treatment

## Polymicrobial infections
## ______________________________________________
These are more common in injection drug users, or in patients who have had
recent abdominal surgery or trauma, vulvo-vaginal infection, or genital or
rectal abscess.
## Preferred Treatment:
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h ($$) [R] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg](orz-set-abx-pip-tazo-3-375-clinda-900-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
IV q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
< OR >
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h](orz-set-abx-ceft-clinda-900mg-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R] < OR >
[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
## Alternatives for penicillin allergy
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h ($) [R,DI] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV](orz-set-abx-cipro-400-clinda-900-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
q8h ($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R] < OR >
[Gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($) [R,O] <AND> clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h](orz-set-abx-gent-5mg-kg-clinda-900-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
($$) [H,O] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
